Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Johnny Tullner writes:
> If you are the victim of Hidden Lurker, can you play additional strike cards
> even though you can't actually strike?

Yes:

* You can gain additional strikes even if you cannot strike. You still
cannot strike with the additional strike, however. [LSJ 970821]

> Also, I assume under Thought's Betrayed that you *can* additional strike.

You can gain additional strikes, sure.
But you still can't play strike cards for those strikes.

> If I play Dawn Operation and Drawing Out the Beast (superior), can I
> Decapitate my opponent when they go to torpor? I think
> Dawn Op/Weather Control/Decapitate (and skin of night your own damage) is
> the same situation.

Yes.
